    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) assert `genActualType(op1) == genActualType(op2)` in fgOptimizeRelationalComparisonWithConst for byref vs static address #134478
    12.0.0

    12.0.0

    12.0.0

    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) multi-reg struct arg load re-reads the heap address per register (torn struct values) #134474
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) big-offset field load in a call argument is hoisted above the null check of an earlier argument (AV instead of NRE) #134473
    12.0.0
  • XmlReader is allocation-heavy when processing many non-seekable Streams #134472
  • [wasm] Wasm encoding of reading from array is unnecessarily large #134465

  • JIT: (bug) assert `genActualType(op1) == genActualType(op2)` - range check cloning builds mixed-width (int/long) guard conditions #134459
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) assert `phiFound || ...` in SSA for a filter whose mutually-protecting sibling catch contains a try/finally #134457
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) bounds check removed for `x >>> (y & 3)` when `x` may be negative #134455
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) `IsMonotonicallyIncreasing` accepts a negative seed behind `lcl + (lcl + cns)`, relop folded incorrectly #134454
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) `(uint)i < (uint)n` wrongly implies `i >= 0` when `n` is a checked bound elsewhere #134453
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) range analysis treats int<->float casts as value-preserving #134452
    12.0.0
